_comment: Packages that expose a license URL instead of an SPDX expression. LinkId=329770 is the MICROSOFT .NET LIBRARY license (proprietary but freely redistributable with the package) - mapped to its own identifier, which allowed-licenses.json lists explicitly; the dotnet/standard LICENSE.TXT really is MIT. xunit 2.x packages (xunit.abstractions and friends) point at the repo license.txt, which is Apache-2.0.
